name: k3y69b-haiku-connectors
goal: Haiku module workers no longer receive claude.ai connector tools mid-session, so fresh sessions stop hitting the context limit at startup

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Count-only live probes: without --strict-mcp-config the second request adds a role:system message with text+tool_addition blocks (about 56.6k o200k tokens, 93 mcp names); the tools array stays at 7. With the flag that message never appears. Expected: a module worker receives no connector tools.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The CLI relay tests sent short synthetic histories, no test pinned the module worker's MCP isolation, and a single-turn CLI probe ends before connectors load. module-worker-mcp.test.ts now pins the worker command.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 8e0eae8495: module-worker-mcp.test.ts failed on the --strict-mcp-config assertion (loop record red).

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: f7c0d80c3d: add --strict-mcp-config to the Claude module worker command. The admission gate is unchanged from main.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: f7c0d80c3d: the unchanged test passes (loop record green).

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
